response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a skilled full-stack and systems engineer with strong D, TypeScript, and Node.js experience, but he does not meet the core requirements of this role: he lacks recent, substantial C++ development on Windows (only brief C/C++ work at National Instruments in 2014-2015, and no Windows platform focus is mentioned), has no SQL Server or Oracle experience (only MongoDB/MySQL listed), and shows no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure aside from a brief general fintech stint at RIDE Capital using Node/TypeScript/GraphQL.
strengths: Deep and broad software engineering experience across many languages and platforms
Demonstrated experience at a financial-adjacent startup (RIDE Capital)
Excellent communication skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source leadership
concerns: No current or recent hands-on C++ Windows development experience
No SQL Server or Oracle experience; database background is MongoDB/MySQL
No fixed income, derivatives, or capital markets domain expertise

key_factors.factor: Lack of C++ on Windows expertise
No fixed income/capital markets domain experience
